title: AI Engineering roadmap for 2026 By Andrew Ng's #softwarearchitect #coding #agent #aiengineering
description:
What actually separates a real AI Engineer from someone who just "vibe codes"? 

AI pioneer Andrew Ng analyzed over 10,000 job postings and conducted dozens of interviews with tech leaders to map out the 4 Essential Pillars of AI Engineering:

1. Building & Deploying AI Apps: Mastering LLMs, non-deterministic outputs, RAG, context engineering, and statistical eval loops.
2. Software Engineering Fundamentals: Architecture tradeoffs (Latency vs Cost vs Scale) and steering agents with precise system design.
3. Mastering Coding Agents: Spec-driven dev, context window hygiene, planning vs execution, and automated verifiers.
4. Shaping the Build: Product sense, business context, high agency, and defining what gets built.

Subscribe for daily 60-second software engineering & AI architecture breakdowns! 🚀
